title_or_table: Current Population Survey/Housing Vacancy Survey, Annual Statistics 2015 and 2025, Table B-5, margins of error of homeownership rates by age of householder, with the rates of Table 17
table_id: HVS ann15t_b5 and ann25t_b5 (United States column); ann25t_17
universe_or_base: Households, by age of householder: all householders and the five summary age groups
unit: percent; margins are 90 percent margins in percentage points; change and its margin computed and stored to four decimals
qualification: Published margins are rounded to one decimal, so the computed margin of each change is approximate; it treats the two years as independent samples (the root of the summed squares). The 2025 average leaves out October 2025, when no data were collected. A change that does not pass its margin is not a measured change (DR-64).

age_group.description: age of householder, as the tables name the summary groups

change_moe.description: approximate 90 percent margin of the change, computed

change_passes_moe.description: true when the change is larger than its margin

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey/Housing Vacancy Survey, Annual Statistics 2015 and 2025, Tables 17 and B-5, homeownership rate by age of householder with margins of error, 2015 and 2025, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Margins of the changes computed by Oath & Action.
